page.overview:
Who is Deep Cover?

Assigned to an Earth police force as part of an exchange program along with his brother Clamp Down, Deep Cover specializes in solo infiltration missions. He can not only project illusions, but is capable of shrinking himself down to 1/40th his normal size for brief periods of time.

His many years of undercover work have taken their toll on him; though he remains vigilant and a fierce defender of the innocent, he sometimes comes across as very weary, struggling with inner demons.

Deep Cover is one of many many many beings who populate the Offworld Zones of Axiom Nexus.
